subject: infoschema: keep pivot record in v2 schema GC (#66631)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent, focusing on infoschema v2 GC and historical lookup semantics. The change to GC only deletes an old version when the next-newer version for the same key is also < cutVer, preserving the per-table / per-referred-FK “pivot” (latest < cutVer) needed to serve schemaVersion lookups in [cutVer, next change) after MVCC-based cutover; added/updated tests cover the missing-table / missing-referred-FK failure mode. No Blocker/High issues found; no tests/builds run per constraints.
